item.content:encoded:
I might be a little nitpicky, but if it's an outside force which anchors to mirrors, why hasn't it anchored to another mirror yet? Is it because it can't or because it doesn't want / need to? Also, could it anchor to any reflective surface or just to items which are typically considered as a mirror?

I know the foundation is probably currently investigating those questions, but I think the foundation would forbid to bring any highly reflective item into contact with the scip, until this theory is proven wrong.

But overall I really enjoyed it. Especially the way you slowly realise it's "purpose". +1

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
While I do like it, I honestly feel like "safe" isn't a good rating for this SCP. I'd probably place it solidly at "Euclid," considering its more dangerous properties. I guess it would depend on the percent of people it causes to have the desire to pick it up, but seeing that the rate is blocked out, I'm not sure.
I'm upvoting, though, because I'm a sucker for body horror, and I appreciate the suspense of "preparing" for something.

Oh look, another magic mirror.

I could tell from the bit at the end that there was meant to be the implication of this being more than just a mirror of fucks you uppery, but I couldn't really figure it out. The [DATA EXPUNGED] at the end was clumsily done, and the implication just didn't work.

Basically, what I'm trying to say is that this could be good, but isn't. As it stands, it's too similar to SCPs we've had in the past, and really just doesn't stand out.
